expected_skill_registry_entries.statement: class markers are SUPPLIED evidence read off a licensing frame; the consumer never invents a marker it was not given
the naming and action inventories are SUFFICIENT, not necessary: one accepted marker settles the label, and rejection of the other markers is not evidence against it
the residual label is licensed only NEGATIVELY, after both positive inventories have failed to attach and the word cannot stand as an answer
the eight-way English scheme is never imported: a class label is produced by marker acceptance, never by what the word denotes or by its translation category
one nominal and one verbal marker on the same string means two readings, not a winner: preserve both and let vocalization decide upstream
